name: Zacess Cream
description: Black on cream for dyslexia, the reader's Black on cream theme.
toml:
# the Zacess Cream theme as a profile, one of the ten starter profiles
# colours from the Zacess themes palette 0.12.1

spec_version = 1
name = "Zacess Cream"
id = "zacess-cream"
description = "Black on cream for dyslexia, the reader's Black on cream theme."
appearance = "light"

[needs]
reduce_motion = true
cursor_size = "standard"
focus_ring_width_px = 2

[needs.contrast]
text = 7.0
non_text = 3.0
overlay = 4.5
terminal = 7.0
terminal_dim = 4.5
highlight_distance = 0.08
colour_vision_distance = 0.04
tone_difference = 0.05

[needs.font]
family = "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono"
fallback = "monospace"
size_pt = 14

[palette]
background = "#fdf6e3"
foreground = "#000000"
surface = "#f2efe9"
surface_alt = "#e9e5dd"
muted = "#3f382c"
border = "#6e6555"
accent = "#004498"
accent_foreground = "#ffffff"
link = "#004498"
focus_ring = "#004498"
cursor = "#000000"
cursor_text = "#fdf6e3"
selection_background = "#7401ca"
selection_foreground = "#fdf6e3"
selection_soft = "#c8a9ff"
line_highlight = "#c8dadd"
error = "#770004"
# was #513100, which matched the error colour in tone and merged with it under simulated colour
# vision deficiencies; this burnt orange is the most colourful shade that keeps them apart at 7:1
warning = "#803200"
info = "#00357a"

[palette.syntax]
keyword = "#530093"
control = "#550036"
function = "#004498"
type = "#003232"
variable = "#000000"
parameter = "#441f00"
property = "#020068"
string = "#00440c"
number = "#451700"
comment = "#8b0162"
operator = "#000000"
tag = "#530093"
attribute = "#3a1f00"
regex = "#52001c"
invalid = "#540002"
added = "#005512"
removed = "#540002"
changed = "#001538"

[palette.terminal]
ansi = [
    "#000000", "#c1000a", "#016f1b", "#815601",
    "#015ac2", "#a901a6", "#016969", "#434343",
    "#484848", "#df0010", "#008120", "#966501",
    "#0069e3", "#c500bf", "#027b7b", "#000000",
]
dim = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14]

check.output:
pass profiles/zacess-cream.toml (Zacess Cream)
     224 pairs against text 7:1, non-text 3:1, overlay 4.5:1, terminal 7:1 and dim terminal 4.5:1, with paired colours 0.05 apart in tone and 0.04 under colour vision deficiencies
     tightest warning #803200 on surface_alt #e9e5dd: 7.04:1
